QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Top Secret Documents
QuestInfo.0: You have to persuade #bAlora#k to leave Aspire and come with you to the hideout.\r\nTalk with Alora again.
QuestInfo.1:
#bAlora#k won't be swayed without #bhard evidence#k.
What if you show her a #btop secret document#k about Wondroid production?
You should be able to obtain various #bwork orders#k from #bemployees#k in the labs.
You might also find a #bWondroid Research Diary#k detailing the inhumane experiments in one of the boxes located at Aspire Industries.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the secret documents to #bAlora#k.\r\nHow will she react?

item.0: #bKrania#k treats us with love and respect.\r\nI could never believe such nonsense. Bring me #bconcrete proof#k, or stop wasting the company's time.
